## American Airlines Carry-On Fluid Requirements

American Airlines defers entirely to the **TSA (Transportation Security Administration)** for liquid rules at security checkpoints. The governing standard is the **TSA 3-1-1 Rule**, which applies to all domestic U.S. flights regardless of airline.

---

### The TSA 3-1-1 Rule

The name "3-1-1" is a quick memory aid for the three core requirements:

| Component | Requirement |
|---|---|
| **3.4 oz / 100 ml** | Each individual liquid container must be 3.4 ounces (100 milliliters) or less |
| **1 quart-sized bag** | All liquid containers must fit inside a single, clear, quart-sized, zip-top plastic bag |
| **1 bag per passenger** | Only one such bag is allowed per traveler |

> **Important:** If a container is *larger* than 3.4 oz, it is **not allowed** through security — even if the actual amount of liquid remaining inside is 3.4 oz or less. The container size itself is what matters.

---

### What Counts as a "Liquid"?

The rule applies broadly to **liquids, aerosols, gels, creams, and pastes**, including common items such as:

- Shampoo, conditioner, and body wash
- Toothpaste and mouthwash
- Deodorant (gel or spray)
- Lotion, sunscreen, and aloe vera
- Perfume and cologne
- Hairspray and hair gel
- Lip gloss
- Food items in liquid/gel/paste form (e.g., peanut butter, yogurt, jam)

**Powders** (e.g., baby powder, some makeup) are generally not restricted, though quantities over 12 oz (350 ml) must be placed in a separate bin for X-ray screening.

---

### Key Exceptions

Certain items are **exempt** from the 3-1-1 rule and may be brought in larger quantities:

| Item | Exception |
|---|---|
| **Prescription & OTC medications** | Medically necessary liquids are allowed in reasonable quantities; remove from bag and notify TSA |
| **Baby formula & breast milk** | Allowed in quantities exceeding 3.4 oz; remove from bag and notify TSA |
| **Hand sanitizer** | Up to **12 oz (354 ml)** is currently permitted (screened separately) |
| **Duty-free liquids (international)** | Allowed if purchased internationally, packed in a **tamper-evident, transparent bag** by the retailer, with receipt showing purchase within the last 48 hours |

---

### Practical Tips

- Pack all your liquids in a **clear, resealable quart-sized bag** and place it at the top of your carry-on for easy removal at the checkpoint.
- If you have **TSA PreCheck**, you typically do not need to remove your liquids bag, though it is still subject to the 3-1-1 limits.
- Any liquid that **alarms during screening** will require additional inspection.
- Anything over 3.4 oz should be packed in your **checked baggage**.

For any item you are unsure about, the [TSA's "What Can I Bring?" tool](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/whatcanibring/all) allows you to search specific items before you travel. You can also text "AskTSA" on Twitter/X or via SMS.
